stories.title: Witkoff and Kushner call Kyiv talks 'substantive,' push for trilateral format with Russia
stories.reason: In their first-ever visit to Ukraine, Trump's envoys met Zelenskyy after three hours with Putin in Moscow, with both sides now open to reviving three-way talks -- the most concrete diplomatic movement on the war in months.

stories.title: Trump renews threat to strike Iran's fortified 'Pickaxe Mountain' nuclear site
stories.reason: The underground facility near Natanz is one of Iran's last untouched nuclear sites, and Iranian officials warn a direct strike would trigger heavy retaliation, raising the stakes just as US-Iran clashes hit a third exchange this week.

stories.title: AI agents helped a hacker breach an enterprise network and steal root credentials in under 10 hours
stories.reason: A Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 investigation found the attacker used frontier AI models to compress an intrusion that would normally take human red teams two weeks into a single automated overnight operation.

stories.title: Kushner says Israeli government acting 'a little irrational' on Gaza ahead of Knesset election
stories.reason: The unusually blunt comment from Trump's own envoy exposes friction between Washington and Netanyahu's government over stalled plans to disarm Hamas and complete an Israeli withdrawal from Gaza.

stories.title: Trump's super PAC makes its first major midterm move: a $10 million Texas Senate ad blitz
stories.reason: The ads target Democratic nominee James Talarico on taxes, signaling that a once-safe Republican Senate seat is now considered competitive enough to warrant an early, aggressive defense.

stories.title: Ukrainian drones strike a Russian oil refinery in Ryazan despite the Kyiv-Moscow strike pause
stories.reason: The overnight strikes on Rostov Oblast, hospitalizing a child, show the reciprocal pause on capital strikes hasn't stopped fighting elsewhere even as US-brokered peace talks continue.

stories.title: Stocks fall and rate-hike odds jump to 63% after blowout August jobs report
stories.reason: The Dow dropped more than 270 points as 162,000 new jobs -- triple expectations -- pushed the 10-year Treasury yield to 4.78% and revived the case for a Fed rate hike this month.

stories.title: Nearly 600,000 evacuated as Typhoon Saudel floods China's Fujian province, collapsing over 100 homes
stories.reason: Putian recorded 416.5mm of rain in two days, breaking its September record, with multiple people missing and firefighters wading through waist-deep water to rescue elderly residents in Fuding.
